context: A rural local hosts a uni reporter for an evening meal
purpose: Teach: お薦め/デパート/倶楽部/焼酎/ハム/手軽/ゆったり/きちっと

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 遠いところまでよう来てくれた。今晩のお薦め料理は、嫁が漬けた生ハムと、うちの芋焼酎じゃ。
lines.en: Thanks for coming all this way. Tonight's recommended dishes are my wife's homemade prosciutto and our sweet potato shochu.
lines.style: Warm rural elder welcoming a guest sincerely

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わあ、ありがとうございます。きちっと挨拶もせずすみません。デパート地下のハムしか知らなかったので、本物は初めてです。
lines.en: Wow, thank you. Sorry for not greeting you properly. I only knew department-store ham, so this is my first taste of the real thing.
lines.style: Polite young reporter, slightly flustered but curious

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ここではゆったりしてくれ。村の倶楽部の年寄りも、若い記者さんと話したがっとる。県民の声を東京に届けてくれよ。
lines.en: Relax and take it easy here. The old folks at the village club also want to talk with a young reporter. Bring the prefectural voices to Tokyo.
lines.style: Hospitable invitation paired with civic hope and warmth

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もちろんです。今回の取材は原発事故からの復興がテーマで、現場の悲惨な状況を学生にも伝えたくて。
lines.en: Of course. This assignment focuses on recovery from the nuclear accident, and I want to convey the tragic situation on the ground to students too.
lines.style: Earnest journalist explaining serious purpose, personal cadence that sets them apart

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: あの時はうちの土も汚染されてな、除去作業に何年もかかった。早急に手を打ってもらえれば、と何度思ったか。
lines.en: Back then our soil was contaminated, and the removal work took years. I lost count of how many times I wished they had acted urgently.
lines.style: Reflective grief, weighty memory of disaster

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 脆弱な地域ほどしわ寄せが来るんですね。実現不能と言われた農地の再生、よくここまで戻されました。
lines.en: It's the vulnerable regions that bear the brunt, isn't it. They said farmland recovery was impossible, yet you brought it this far.
lines.style: Respectful analytical observation from a student

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 鎌倉時代から続く土地だ、簡単には諦めん。さあ、手軽なつまみだが、太平洋で獲れた魚も食ってくれ。
lines.en: This land has continued since the Kamakura era; we don't give up easily. Come, these are simple snacks, but try the fish caught in the Pacific too.
lines.style: Proud heritage paired with humble hospitality

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いただきます。村との友好関係を大事にしながら、記事もきちんと書きます。
lines.en: Thank you for the meal. I'll cherish our friendship with the village and write the article properly.
lines.style: Grateful closing pledge from the reporter
